🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector breadth (≥7/11) and cyclicals leadership (Financials and Industrials showing ABOVE TREND names such as JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 performers are 5/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND and the bank cohort driving a +5.31% 1W; Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND with ETN (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND; Technology (semis) leadership: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is the clear laggard: Energy (Breadth weak) with PSX (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND and broader weakness (-3.03% 1W). Communication and Healthcare are softer relative to the leaders: Communication shows mixed readings with META in RECOVERY (1W: +8.49% | 1M: -3.84%) while Healthcare has name dispersion (JNJ (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +16.44%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +15.01%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — caution on single-sector dominance.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -14.81% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -13.68% | 1M: -22.98%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -10.92% | 1M: -13.66%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -13.43%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple software and select consumer/energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META all show 1W/1M mismatches) — treat recent moves as tactical and watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Semiconductors driving Tech: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +16.44%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +15.01%) ABOVE TREND; broader tech mix with AAPL in RECOVERY (1W: +1.90% | 1M: -0.13%) and NVDA in RECOVERY (1W: +4.64% | 1M: -0.46%). Sector breadth: Technology: 18/24 positive (internal rotation toward semis).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials strong and broad: JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND with the sector up 1W +5.31%; multiple banks and payment names contributing. Sector breadth: Financials: 17/20 positive — favorable backdrop for cyclicals/value exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: UNH (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND driving strength while JNJ (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND shows defensive dispersion. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 11/17 positive — selective opportunities around names with clear catalysts.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and semiconductor exposures given the current rotation into Financials, Industrials and semis (JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to isolated losers and crowded high-multiple software laggards (INTU, NOW, PLTR) and monitor Energy names for further downside. Style: mixed / no clear leadership beyond semiconductor concentration.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -14.81% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -13.68% | 1M: -22.98%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -13.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth: Financials: 17/20 positive) and Industrials (Breadth: Industrials: 13/15 positive) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Energy (Breadth: Energy: 3/10 positive) for downside risk; Communication to watch for dispersion given mixed headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for failure to reclaim its 1-month pivot (RECOVERY risk) as a sign of momentum roll; AAPL support near the recent 1W lift (AAPL (1W: +1.90% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY) is a tactical trigger; JPM above recent breakout (JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND) signals cyclical continuation; INTC strength should be monitored for mean-reversion after a 1W spike.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
META (+65): Meta expands CoreWeave deal; price RECOVERY (1W: +8.49% | 1M: -3.84%) — news confirming short-term strength. AMD (+55): Agentic AI and megadeals; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +16.44%) — sentiment confirmed. AMAT (+55): new tech catalyst; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +15.01%) — confirmed. TXN (+50): upgrade and AI flow; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +8.87%) — confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
HD (-60): Home Depot warns on demand; price RECOVERY (1W: +3.04% | 1M: -4.28%) — sentiment diverging from 1W strength, watch for follow-through. AVGO (-50): downgrade note but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +3.82%) — distribution signal, watch volatility. INTU (-50): Anthropic/FedNow fears; price BELOW TREND (1W: -14.81% | 1M: -20.08%) — sentiment confirmed. PSX (-55): derivatives loss headline; price BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.88%) — confirmed risk.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth 10/11 sectors positive with cyclicals confirming leadership. INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-cap growth names (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META show 1W/1M mismatches) and headline-driven weakness in INTU/PSX — watch for trend breaks and treat recent exuberance as tactical.
